entries.reason: non-durable sessions in the session store (sidekicks, one-shots, consults, masons, other modules); only sessions marked durable are backed up, in session-store-durable, and none live in this tree
sessions in the session store with caller-chosen retention; an immutable backup snapshot would outlive that promise
staged uploads are temporary input, not durable session data; an immutable backup snapshot would outlive their expiry
System One batch answers hold caller text and are kept seven days after first admission; an immutable backup snapshot would outlive that promise, and a lost batch is re-sent and answered again

grants are consent decisions and losing one only means the person is asked again; held calls carry request content and are kept seven days after first admission, so an immutable backup would outlive that promise
